thread:
lina: huge shout — we just crossed $10M ARR this quarter 🚀🥂

harry: no way!! thats amazing, congrats team!! :tada:

mika: omg thats massive. ramen truck + commemorative socks pls :ramen: :socks:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary -> prod completed (v3.0) ✔️

lina: planning a small in-office thing next week. options: 1) rooftop toast, 2) ramen truck, 3) socks + sticker packs, 4) tiny posters for the wall. vote by reacting 1-4.

remote-ella: remote folks vote for #3 — ship care packages please! 

harry: also idk who to tag but massive props to sales + solutions for the deal, and infra for handling the spike last week. put together a shoutout doc?

tara-ic: ill make a 1-slide shoutout summary for the all-hands. will include a few fun stats (ARR, avg qtr growth, key customers).

mika: can we get the exact number on the poster? like $10,023,412 — the ugly precise number is fun. :frame_with_picture:

lina: love that. tara please include exacts. also adding a little ritual: plant watering + sticker signing when we print the poster.

harry: minor nerd flex: during launch our 99th percentile stayed under 220ms across regions. tiny confetti for runtime team. :confetti_ball:

remote-ella: will take a selfie with the socks when they arrive and post in #random. promise.

lina: ok done. plan: ramen + socks + poster. logistics chat thread on monday. thanks team 1 — back to inboxes :sparkles:
